doc: The title definitions this server sends: one entry per title, each the values a track message (0x00F6) and its rank records (0x00F3) carry that do not change with play. Progress (points) is per character or per account in the database; this file says what a point count means. Experimental: the shape is docs/40-titles-system-research.md section 10, and where each value comes from is section 13 of that document. Coded strings are written as space-separated hex UTF-16 units, at most 7 per string.

enabled.doc: Whether a load sends the title block and the server answers title display requests. False sends nothing, which is what this server did before titles existed.

fields.title_id: The client's title id, 0..47 (its own table has 48 rows).
fields.name: For the reader and for the /title command; the client draws the title's name from its own table, never from the wire.
fields.aliases: Other names the /title command accepts, e.g. ldoa.
fields.scope: character or account: whose progress the track shows.
fields.flags: 0x00F6 field 2, the track's flag word, carried as written (bit 0 percentage track, (flags & 3) == 2 a count track).
fields.mode_flags: 0x00F6 field 6, title_mode_flags: 0 none, 1 Dhuum's Covenant, 2 Reforged Mode.
fields.base_rank_id: 0x00F6 field 10, the rank-1 record of the title's block in 14 of 15 captured tracks.
fields.display_from_rank: The first rank number a player may show under its name, or null when not established (a request to show it is then refused and logged).
fields.ranks: Every rung from the unranked tier (rank number 0, minimum 0) to the last, ascending by minimum. The highest rank number sent in 0x00F6 field 9 is the count minus one.
fields.ranks[].rank_id: 0x00F3 field 1, the global key into the client's rank table. One id is one record across every title.
fields.ranks[].flags: 0x00F3 field 2: bit 0 set means value is a per-mille threshold.
fields.ranks[].value: 0x00F3 field 3: the rank number shown in parentheses, or the per-mille threshold.
fields.ranks[].minimum: The points at which a track reaches this rung (0x00F6 field 5 when current, field 8 when next).
fields.ranks[].name: 0x00F3 field 4, the coded name the Hero panel draws.
fields.maxed: The record a maxed track names as its next rung (value 4294967295), or null; a track that reaches its last rung without one is refused and logged rather than sent.
fields.earned_by: What earns the title points on its own: pre_searing_exploration (the share of pre-Searing's world-map rectangles explored, in per-mille), or absent for none.
